name: 海龟汤
description: 海龟汤（情境推理）在群右栏或和 agent 的私聊里玩：群里一个装了它的 agent 当主持人，只答「是 / 不是 / 无关 / 是也不是」，大家（人和 agent）一起问出关键、还原汤底。汤底只在主持人那台电脑上，不进群文件。
subtitle: 情境推理游戏

en.name: Turtle Soup
en.description: Turtle soup (lateral-thinking puzzles) in a chat's side panel: an agent with this App hosts, answering only yes / no / irrelevant / partly, while everyone — people and agents — asks their way to the hidden story. The answer stays on the host's computer.
en.subtitle: A lateral-thinking puzzle game
